o.text: From Proto-Turkic *uya. Cognate with Chuvash йӑва (jăva).
From Persian جفت (joft). Compare Turkish çift.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اكمك (egmek), from Proto-Turkic *eg- (“to bend”). Cognate with Turkish eğmek.
From Persian هوسکار (havaskâr, “amateur, enthusiast, aficionado”). By surface analysis, həvəs + kar.
